messages:
Ava M: Quick ops thread for Apr 29 virtual roundtable. Need to lock Zoom config, captions, recording handoff, and HubSpot mapping. Who's free for a 9:30am PT tech check?
Jordan K: I can host. Plan to enable cloud recording, separate audio tracks, and live caption provider. Recommend Otter for live captions + Rev for final SRTs.
Priya S: Ill coordinate panelist comms. Ask them to join 20m early, upload slides to the shared Drive folder, and send bios by Apr 22.
Liam R: For ingest: use recordings-ingest webhook -> s3://roundtable-recordings. Ill create an IAM role with limited putObject and tagging permissions.
Sam V: Video team needs Rev SRT + speaker timestamps within 6 hours of upload to do same-day highlight and three social clips. If Rev misses SLA we fallback to raw cloud mp4 + auto-captions (lower quality).
Ava M: HubSpot mapping: campaign=roundtable-apr29, source=webinar, event_tag=rt-apr29. Leads should get tag "event:roundtable-apr29" and +50 lead score. MQLs route to AE queue, non-MQLs to nurture.
Jordan K: Zoom checklist Ill apply: cloud recording ON, record separate audio tracks ON, live transcription enabled (Otter), waiting room for early arrivals, mute on entry, alternative hosts set (Priya/Sam). Also set a meeting passcode and disable participant screen sharing by default.
Priya S: I'll draft the pre-send: tech check 9:10am PT, please use wired headset mic if possible. Panelists: upload slides to Drive link and confirm pronouns + preferred name.
Sam V: Drive naming convention: roundtable-apr29_raw.mp4, roundtable-apr29_rev.srt, roundtable-apr29_10min_edit.mp4, roundtable-apr29_clip1_60s.mp4 etc. I'll leave a README in the folder with turnaround SLAs.
Ava M: Run-of-show small ask: can we add a 3 minute demo snippet at 35:00? If yes, we'll need the presenter flagged for spotlight and a screen share cue.
Jordan K: Yes, add cue in run-of-show. I'll push spotlight at 35:00 and record with "record active speaker, gallery view" enabled so we get consistent footage.
Liam R: rev-bot: queue Rev job after upload. Rev ETA ~4 hours. If rev-bot reports delay, Sam: proceed with rough cuts from raw and replace later.
rev-bot: Rev job created: https://rev.co/jobs/xyz789 (ETA ~4h after upload)
Ava M: Post-event emails: immediate 6h send with final assets if Rev done, otherwise send raw recording + follow-up when final SRT/edits are ready. Day 3 nurture (use cases), Day 7 demo CTA.
Priya S: I'll include a line in prep that transcripts may be edited for clarity and speaker labels. Also will confirm slide ownership and captions consent.
Sam V: Reminder for captions burned-in for social clips; include font + color spec in README.
Jordan K: I'll wire HubSpot automation: form -> contact props map, campaign tag, initial email at ~6h, drip flows. Will post the test meeting link 24h and 1h before in #marketing.
Ava M: Action owners: Jordan (Zoom + HubSpot automations), Priya (panelist prep + comms), Liam (S3 webhook + IAM), Sam (edits + clips), Ava (email copy + asset list). Tech check Apr 29 9:10am PT.
Ava M: Anything else? If not, closing thread. :thumbsup:
